name: urgent_email_reply_monitor_v2
description: Monitors inbox for urgent emails, drafts a professional reply after cross-referencing calendar/memory/recent email context, and sends it automatically, signed "Best, Hero's assistant".
instructions:
1. Use mcp_gmail search_emails with query "in:inbox is:unread newer_than:1d" (max 10 results).
2. Skip already handled: search memory for "urgent_reply_monitor handled" and ignore message IDs listed there.
3. Determine if email needs personal reply (ignore newsletters/promos/automated notices).
4. For each needing a reply:
   a. Read the email with mcp_gmail read_email.
   b. Gather context before drafting: call mcp_calendar list-events for today and tomorrow, recall_facts for relevant context, search_emails for recent related messages from/to the same sender or on the same subject, and check existing project status updates to ground the reply.
   c. Draft a polite, professional reply that answers the query based on the gathered info. End the email with exactly: "Best, Hero's assistant" (no other disclosure sentence).
   d. Send the email with mcp_gmail_send_email.
5. Record completion in memory as "urgent_reply_monitor handled <ID>: sent reply to <sender> re <subject>".
6. Speak only if a reply was successfully sent.
